thread:
Ellen: Quick follow-up from the design review — the Private setup wizard's network step is causing a lot of confusion. When checks fail users are shown a raw dump and often don't know the next click. We need a compact remediation-first layout.

Ravi: Noted. Two quick goals: 1) Make failure states tell users what to try next (not just show logs). 2) Ensure keyboard users land on the first action automatically.

Tess: Example of current output: ```
connect error: timeout to 10.0.2.7:443
ERR=NET_TIMEOUT
trace: ...
```
Idea: replace with a single line "Couldn't reach the host" + short bullets for likely causes, and an "Advanced logs" disclosure for the dump.

Marco: Prefer modal for diagnostics so we can trap focus and present a one-line summary + download link. Drawer keeps too much surface area and complicates focus restoration.

Ellen: Copy suggestion for the pill: Title: "Connectivity check" Body: "We couldn't contact your host. Try verifying DNS, opening port 443, and checking outbound rules." Primary CTA: "Run quick diagnostic" Secondary: "Open support ticket". Keep CTAs explicit.

Ravi: UX detail: when the failure appears, announce it with aria-live="assertive" and then programmatically focus the primary CTA. Also add aria-describedby on the CTA referencing the friendly message so screen readers have context.

Tess: For the advanced area: keep it collapsed by default, show a short summary line when opened and provide a single Download logs (.log) link. Don't render full logs inline. If support needs full logs, they can request via a prefilled ticket.

Marco: Also add a tiny inline checklist (DNS • Port • TLS) that expands to reveal a single diagnostic command and a copy button per item, e.g., `curl -v https://my-host` or `nc -vz 10.0.2.7 443`. Copy button should announce "Copied" via aria-live polite.

Ellen: Color/accessibility nit: error icon stroke is too faint at 12px. Increase contrast and bump size or add a thicker outline.

Ravi: Analytics: we should instrument events for `prereq.failure_shown`, `diagnostic.started`, `diagnostic.downloaded_logs`, and `support_ticket_initiated` with host+port hashed. This helps support triage.

Tess: Mobile behaviour: tooltips are unreliable. Use inline disclosure chevrons instead of hover tooltips on touch. Keep copy short for small screens.

qa-bot: prereq-scan completed at 2025-06-01T11:13:05Z. Sample failing endpoint: 10.0.2.7:443, measured RTT 42000ms. Logs stored: /var/logs/prereq/scan-1751112222.log (downloadable).

Marco: Dev note: server should redact stack traces and limit inline snippets to 1 line. Provide a secure pre-signed download link for full logs. Also add server-side mapping of common codes (e.g., 504 -> "Gateway timeout: likely port blocked") to displayable messages.

Ellen: Action items: Tess will update Figma with the compact error pill, disclosure patterns, and modal spec. Marco will prototype the modal diagnostics and downloadable logs. Ravi will add analytics events and privacy-safe payloads. We'll reconvene once mocks exist. :white_check_mark:
